item.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup - Semi-Finals & Final
item.description: Final four: France, Spain, England, Argentina. Semis air 5am AEST Wed 15 & Thu 16 Jul; final Sun 19 Jul. Go England!

item.title: Wimbledon 2026 Wraps Up
item.description: Jannik Sinner (Italy) won the Men's singles and Linda Noskova (Czech Republic) the Women's. No Aussies took home trophies this year.

item.title: July Long Service Readers Book Club - Tue 14 July 1pm
item.description: Postponed from last week. Meets Tuesday 14 July at 1pm in the L5 breakout to share what you're reading. All welcome - bring your lunch or a coffee.

item.title: Lunchtime Pilates Is Back for July
item.description: Lunchtime Pilates classes return for July as a four-week series - a good way to keep moving as winter settles in. See the All Staff channel for details.

item.title: Security Passes - Always Carry Yours On Site
item.description: Following a building access audit, staff must always carry their assigned pass on site. Spare passes are emergency once-offs only; report a lost pass immediately.

item.title: ISO/IEC 27001 Stage 2 Certification Audit - 21-23 July
item.description: Auditor on site at 478 Albert Street 21-23 July. Please follow clear desk, secure storage and device-locking practices. Just keep doing what we do every day.

item.title: EOI - Present the Acknowledgement of Country at Town Hall
item.description: Interested in presenting the Acknowledgement of Country at a Town Hall? Sign up via the All Staff channel. Your voice can make the moment meaningful for all of us.

item.title: Food Storage - Check Your Perishables
item.description: Expired, mouldy items are being found and discarded from the L5 fridges. Please keep an eye on your perishables and dispose of them.

item.title: Ground Floor Meeting Rooms - Book Setup Help Early
item.description: Booked a Ground Floor room and need setup or pack-down help? Email Reception and Nathan Crick 24-48 hours ahead, and allow 30 minutes before your meeting.

item.title: Annual Conflict of Interest Declaration - Action Now
item.description: Due by end June and only 50% of staff have completed it. Please check your email and complete the online declaration - it takes a couple of minutes.

item.title: Wellness Corner - Choose Organic When Possible
item.description: This week's tip: choose organic foods when you can. They can be better for your health, the environment, and the farmworkers growing your food.

item.title: Town Hall Presentations Available on The Hub
item.description: Missed a Town Hall? You can catch up on all the presentations via The Hub.

item.title: Open Roles - Now Hiring
item.description: Two roles are open on our Team Tailor recruitment platform: Consultant - Service Investigations, and Head of Product.

item.description: Seen a colleague living our values? Check out the Q2 LOVE Awards nominees and winners on CoINVEST News.
